card.title: Nintendo Switch Component Identification Using a Multimeter Resistance Setting

claims.statement: Set the digital multimeter dial on highest resistance in ohm section.
claims.quote: 1. Set the digital multimeter dial on highest resistance in ohm section.

claims.statement: If reading shows zero when measuring resistance across two ends, it is an inductor.
claims.quote: 3. If reading shows zero, it is an inductor.

claims.statement: If reading shows some constant value other than 1, it is a resistor.
claims.quote: 4. If reading shows some constant value other than “1” then it is a resistor.

claims.statement: If reading keeps increasing and finally settles on 1 on the highest resistance range, it is a capacitor.

procedure: {'step': 'Set the digital multimeter dial on highest resistance in the ohm section.'}
{'step': 'Connect the probes to two ends of the unknown component, ignoring polarity.'}
{'step': 'Check if the reading shows zero, which indicates an inductor.'}
{'step': 'Check if the reading shows a constant value other than 1, which indicates a resistor.'}
{'step': 'Check if the reading keeps increasing and finally settles on 1, which indicates a capacitor.'}

card.caveats: This identification method applies to loose or isolated passive components using resistance mode.
